design_rationale: V3 executed successfully but its runner applied Holm correction separately within each primary endpoint (5 tests + 5 tests), while the preregistration required one Holm family across all 10 time-resolved endpoint/contrast tests. V3 DATA are preserved and not treated as a valid confirmatory analysis. R1 fixes only this analysis-family implementation, uses fresh evaluation seeds, and otherwise preserves the frozen design and endpoint semantics.

matched_budgets.edge_count_rule: sum_i min(4, N-i-1), identical for all conditions

provenance.fixed_weight_source: EXP-S1-TOPO-V2-20260918 preregistered activity calibration selected 55.0 before V2 evaluation
provenance.analysis_correction: R1 corrects the primary multiple-testing family to one Holm correction across all 10 preregistered time-resolved tests.

evaluation.primary_test: exact two-sided paired sign test on non-zero differences
evaluation.primary_multiple_testing: Single Holm correction across all 10 primary time-resolved endpoint/contrast tests
evaluation.replication_test: exact two-sided paired sign test on non-zero first-output-latency differences
evaluation.replication_multiple_testing: Holm correction across the 5 replication contrasts
evaluation.effect_interval: deterministic paired bootstrap 95% CI for the median difference, 5000 resamples

endpoint_definitions.activation_auc_0_32: Sum over ticks 0..31 inclusive of cumulative_unique_active_neurons(t)/64, evaluated after each network.step(). This is a discrete cumulative-activation area measure, not a continuous-time integral.
endpoint_definitions.half_activation_latency_censored: First zero-based tick at which cumulative_unique_active_neurons(t)/64 >= 0.5; if never reached within the 128-tick evaluation window, encode 129.
endpoint_definitions.first_output_latency_censored: First zero-based tick with any spike in output labels 60..63; if absent within 128 ticks, encode 129.

decision_rule.ceiling_resolution_supported: At least one preregistered low-dimensional contrast (1d->2d or 2d->3d) is significant after Holm correction for activation_auc_0_32 or half_activation_latency_censored and its bootstrap CI excludes zero.
decision_rule.replication_supported: All five first_output_latency_censored contrasts have the same negative right-minus-left direction observed in V2, Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, and bootstrap CI excluding zero.
decision_rule.supported_within_protocol: design integrity PASS AND the single-family Holm analysis across all 10 primary tests yields ceiling_resolution_supported AND replication_supported.
decision_rule.partial_support: design integrity PASS and exactly one of ceiling_resolution_supported or replication_supported is true.
decision_rule.no_detected_support: design integrity PASS and neither criterion is met.

interpretation_boundary: This R1 protocol corrects the V3 primary multiple-testing implementation and is an internal preregistered Stage-1 replication/robustness test of RQ-SNN-003/H-SNN-003-B. It does not constitute independent external replication, does not test a 5D advantage, does not establish scaling, cognition or biological equivalence, and creates DATA rather than EVID.
